Thank you all for being here. As you know, I've received Grandma's 90-by-60-centimeter stained-glass window, and I want to get it displayed in the family home before our autumn gathering. We have three location options — the south-facing breakfast-room window, the west hallway, or the reading room — and we'll need to decide on a protective covering and lighting, either focused spotlights or a diffuse wall wash.
